coreRule: The Black Deck converts Adrian's conscious commitment to consequential choices into controlled card-energy. It does not manipulate luck, probability, fate, timelines or other people's decisions.

deckStructure.visual: matte black cards with restrained gold linework; energized cards show black-gold edge light; Ace of Spades is the signature card
deckStructure.ownership: The Deck answers only to its chosen Guardian. A stolen card becomes inert outside the Guardian's active energy field.
deckStructure.recoveryRule: A released or destroyed manifested card dissolves into black-gold energy and returns to the Deck only after its stored Volition Energy has fully discharged. Cards cannot be duplicated permanently.

energyGeneration.source: Adrian making and committing to a real choice whose outcome matters to him or others
strongChargeConditions: Adrian understands that at least one alternative must be abandoned
Adrian accepts responsibility for the result
weakOrNoChargeConditions: actions performed under total coercion with no meaningful agency
attempts to fake conviction only to charge the Deck
energyGeneration.rule: No more than seven cards may hold combat-ready Volition charge simultaneously. Charging an eighth before releasing one causes feedback.

SPADES.effect: focused cutting or piercing energy projected through thrown cards or the Royal Cane
SPADES.combatRole: precision offense, armor breach, cutting bindings or hostile energy constructs

HEARTS.effect: creates compact black-gold wards that absorb or redirect incoming force
HEARTS.combatRole: defense, protecting civilians, holding a line
HEARTS.restriction: Hearts do not heal wounds or resurrect anyone

DIAMONDS.effect: changes the path of released card-energy, enabling ricochet geometry, temporary footholds or directional barriers
DIAMONDS.combatRole: mobility, battlefield positioning, trick shots, controlled redirection

CLUBS.effect: releases concussive force rather than cutting force
CLUBS.combatRole: knockback, breaking mechanisms, disarming and crowd control

rankFunctions.2_TO_10: Standard combat cards. Rank represents safe energy capacity; higher ranks can carry more Volition Energy but require stronger commitment and greater physical control.
rankFunctions.JACK: FEINT. After release, a Jack can create one false continuation of the card's trajectory for a fraction of a second, forcing an opponent to read the wrong line. It does not create a physical clone.
rankFunctions.QUEEN: WARD. Converts its stored charge into a larger defensive lattice. Best defensive face card; movement is limited while maintaining it.
rankFunctions.KING: COMMAND LINE. Links the Black Deck to the Royal Cane, allowing Adrian to control the direction and timing of up to three already-charged cards within his immediate combat field.
rankFunctions.ACE: DECISIVE RELEASE. Each Ace is the maximum expression of its suit and consumes all currently stored Volition charge when activated.

ACE_OF_SPADES.name: FINAL CUT
ACE_OF_SPADES.effect: A single black-gold line of extreme precision that can pierce or sever one chosen target, barrier, weapon or hostile energy structure along a committed trajectory.
ACE_OF_SPADES.restriction: Adrian must choose one target line before release; the attack cannot branch or be redirected after commitment.

ACE_OF_HEARTS.name: LAST STAND
ACE_OF_HEARTS.effect: A dome-like ward centered on a chosen person or position that absorbs a short burst of overwhelming force.
ACE_OF_HEARTS.restriction: Adrian cannot attack with charged cards while maintaining Last Stand.

ACE_OF_DIAMONDS.name: ONE PATH
ACE_OF_DIAMONDS.effect: Creates a short sequence of rigid directional planes that lets Adrian cross open space, redirect a fall or force one released attack through a precisely chosen route.
ACE_OF_DIAMONDS.restriction: The route is fixed the moment the Ace is committed and cannot be changed midway.

ACE_OF_CLUBS.name: HOUSEBREAKER
ACE_OF_CLUBS.effect: A concentrated concussive discharge delivered by card or Royal Cane that can break a heavy mechanism, gate or armored formation without the cutting effect of Spades.
ACE_OF_CLUBS.restriction: Large recoil; unsafe to use in confined civilian spaces without preparation.

functions: physical gentleman's cane and close-combat weapon
allows controlled parries and directional release
required for full King card Command Line technique
royalCane.restriction: The cane has no independent supernatural power without Blackjack and the Black Deck.

functions: conceals inert physical cards and tools
supports misdirection and gentleman-casino combat presentation
topHat.restriction: The Top Hat is not a dimensional storage artifact and does not grant supernatural powers.

limitations.feedbackCondition: Attempting to hold an eighth combat-ready charge causes Choice Burn and forces charge loss.

choiceBurn.cause: overcharging, repeated high-rank releases or using strong Volition while emotionally conflicted

limitations.aceLock: Releasing any Ace empties all stored Volition charge and places the Black Deck in a minimum 20-minute inert recovery state. During this state Adrian can use the cane physically but cannot charge or activate cards.
limitations.commitmentRule: Once a high-tier card is released, Adrian cannot cancel the chosen effect to reclaim the charge. Choice has consequence.
limitations.ethicalRule: The Deck becomes unstable when Adrian repeatedly refuses responsibility for outcomes or uses Choice as an excuse for selfish indecision.

combatIdentity.style: elegant strategist, mobile mid-range card fighter, precision duelist and battlefield controller
combatIdentity.signatureSequence: misdirection with inert cards -> charge through a consequential decision -> controlled suit technique -> Royal Cane reposition -> decisive single-target finish

quarantinedLegacyMechanics: Ace Mode as defined in Royal Gambler legacy
canonFirewall.rule: Legacy Royal Gambler mechanics remain outside Blackjack canon unless Arda explicitly reimports them.
